decisions.reason: The safety shoe line sits at the core of the firm's established footwear knowledge, and its move from a mention to a page of its own in 2024 shows growing commitment.

The comfort insole builds on the firm's orthopaedic and work-shoe expertise, but it has only been mentioned so far and gives little evidence to learn from, so it may be folded into the stronger insole offering.
The supportive insole is closely related to the firm's existing insole know-how, which makes it cheap to keep, although its low visibility suggests it overlaps with the FIT moulded insole.
The ergonomic series draws on the firm's in-house ergonomics R&D and has had a dedicated page in both years, so it fits its absorptive base well.
The firefighter boots extend the firm's certified safety-footwear competence, and the product's promotion to its own page in 2024 indicates a positive early assessment.

The moulded FIT insole has been on the home page in both years and has a concrete market reference in the ALBA Braunschweig FIT-DAY, showing the firm is turning its foot-measurement knowledge into commercial results.
